registration.title: Skill scores adjusted for league, released in the player ratings
registration.what: Production's skill scores take MC-0031: each skill's per-90 score less the offsets of the leagues his window minutes were in, fitted each run from players with 900+ minutes a season in more than one league. The ranks are unchanged.
registration.why: MC-0031 predicted a player's skill numbers in another league about 7.7% better on later moves it hadn't seen, and the owner chose to release it on 2026-10-22.
registration.how: skill_units, skill_league_offsets and the window's league minutes in player_ratings.py, as in experiments/skill_league/DESIGN.md: one new player-model version.
registration.hypothesis: The skill scores are a fairer guide across leagues, with every rank as it was.
registration.success_criteria: No live test: nothing is predicted from the skill scores. The ranks must stay identical (checked by experiments/skill_league/run.py).
